_status: The deck's quick check (slide 16): six RSSO cases a to f, and the answers in its notes (synced 20 October 2026).

items.text: a. A shared login means no one can tell who approved a payout.
items.why: Repudiation: there is no record of who did what, so non-repudiation is broken.

items.text: b. The applicant list is shared by a public link.
c. Someone logs in with Ben's stolen password.
d. A clerk account reaches the admin page.
e. A payout amount is edited in the spreadsheet.
f. Ransomware or floods of traffic take the portal down.
